About Us 
 Halo Recruiting is a white-glove recruiting firm helping U.S. companies access elite global talent for 80% less than domestic equivalents. We recruit, screen, and rigorously vet top-tier remote workers based in the Philippines to work as full-time embedded team members within your business. Our candidates are 100% English-fluent, university-educated, and have years of corporate experience from top-tier brands like Google, KPMG, PwC, Canva, Mercedes-Benz, Exxon, Amazon and Deloitte, to name a few.
 Job Title: Permanent Remote - Python/Javascript Developer 
 Schedule: Full-time, Eastern U.S. business hours
 Compensation: USD $3,500 - $3,800 per month
 About the Role 
 Python & JavaScript Developer 
 Halo Recruiting is partnering with a fast-growing AI technology company that is transforming how B2B sales teams access and use knowledge.
 Their platform uses a codeless, rules-driven approach to create intelligent knowledge solutions that help leading technology brands accelerate sales and deliver better customer experiences.
 We’re looking for a Python & JavaScript Developer to join their technical team and help build, enhance, and maintain applications, APIs, automation tools, and user-facing features.
 What You’ll Do 
Develop and maintain applications using Python and JavaScript 
Build and integrate REST APIs and backend services 
Develop user-facing features and connect them with backend functionality
Build automation tools and solutions that support business and customer needs
Work in Linux environments to configure, run, troubleshoot, and maintain applications
Diagnose technical issues and improve application performance, reliability, and scalability
Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate testing and documentation
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical design and implementation
Collaborate with technical and customer delivery teams to turn requirements into working solutions
 What We’re Looking For 
 3–5 years of professional software development experience 
Strong hands-on experience with Python and JavaScript 
Solid experience working in Linux environments , including command-line tools, shell scripting, permissions, processes, and logs
Experience developing and consuming REST APIs 
Experience with Git or other version control systems
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work
Comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Nice to Have 
Experience with SQL and databases , including relational or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB
Experience developing with Java 
Familiarity with AWS , including EC2, S3, Lambda, or API Gateway
Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, or similar
Experience working with AI, SaaS, automation, or enterprise technology 
 Why This Opportunity? 
 You’ll be joining a growing AI company at an exciting stage, working on technology that is changing how enterprise B2B sales teams operate. This is an opportunity to work across application development, APIs, automation, and AI-driven solutions while collaborating with a team focused on delivering high-impact technology for major brands.
